  Annual Report highlights a busy year for Murray Bridge, with community achievements, infrastructure improvements and continued investment across the region.

- **2026-11-05 — [Celebrating inclusion and connection this International Day of People with Disability](https://www.murraybridge.sa.gov.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0031/2074909/RCMB-Media-Release-International-Day-of-People-with-Disability-Event-2026-1-Copy.pdf)**

- **2026-09-13 — [Sturt Reserve riverfront transformation endorsed](https://landscapeaustralia.com/articles/south-australian-towns-riverfront-set-for-transformation/)**
  Council has endorsed concept designs for a $34 million transformation of the town's riverfront. The Sturt Reserve project will deliver new recreation, play and historic precincts, following endorsement of the Sturt Reserve Masterplan in 2017.

## [SA Police — Murray Mallee](https://www.police.sa.gov.au/)

- **2026-10-22 — [Body located at Murray Bridge](https://www.police.sa.gov.au/sa-police-news-assets/front-page-news/body-located-at-murray-bridge)**
  Police are preparing a report for the Coroner after a man's body was discovered at Murray Bridge. Police were called to a rural property on Ridge Road about 6pm on Wednesday 21 October after the body of a man was located.

- **2026-10-19 — [Body found in water at Murray Bridge](https://www.police.sa.gov.au/sa-police-news-assets/murray-mallee-region/body-found-in-water-at-murray-bridge)**
  Police are preparing a report for the Coroner after a man's body was found at Murray Bridge. The deceased person was later identified as a 78-year-old Victor Harbor man.

## [South Australian Government and Regional Development](https://pir.sa.gov.au/news/regions/tourism-and-accommodation-boost-for-riverland-and-murraylands)

- **2026 — [Tourism and accommodation boost for Riverland and Murraylands](https://pir.sa.gov.au/news/regions/tourism-and-accommodation-boost-for-riverland-and-murraylands)**
  The Albanese Government will contribute $1.75 million to a new tourism offering at Murray Bridge — Bridge Watersport Park. The project will deliver the state's first-ever cable wakeboard park, featuring a permanent aqua park and retail and cafe facilities.

- **2026 — [Sturt Reserve to secure $4.85 million Upgrade](https://www.anthonychisholm.org.au/news-and-media/media-releases-and-transcripts/media-release-sturt-reserve-to-secure-4-85-million-upgrade-under-labor/)**
  A re-elected Albanese Labor Government will deliver $4.85 million for the redevelopment of the Sturt Reserve Precinct. The Pondi Play Space will turn the underutilised reserve into a play precinct for children and families, with a safe, inclusive and accessible open leisure space.

- **2026 — [Climate-resilient planting being pioneered in Murray Bridge](https://www.landscape.sa.gov.au/mr/news/climate-resilient-planting-being-pioneered-in-murray-bridge)**
  The first trial of its kind in South Australia is underway in Murray Bridge, showcasing how native plantings can deliver cooler, greener, and more climate-resilient streetscapes. The woody meadows project is a 5-year trial testing climate-resilient local native plants in hot, dry urban conditions. Visit the site on Swanport Road.

- **2026-08-11 — [Australia Post opens new Murray Bridge delivery centre](https://www.parcelandpostaltechnologyinternational.com/news/logistics/australia-post-opens-new-murray-bridge-delivery-center-in-south-australia.html)**
  Australia Post has opened a new, purpose-built delivery centre in Murray Bridge, the second of four new facilities opening as part of an investment to modernise its delivery network across regional South Australia. The 1,143m2 site can process up to 2,600 parcels per day. Postal services continue at the nearby Murray Bridge Post Office and Murray Bridge South LPO.

## [Business and Development](https://www.raywhite.com/news-and-market-insights/news-media/ray-white-in-strathalbyn-and-murray-bridge-join-forces)

- **2026 — [Murray Bridge Marina & Camping Park changes hands](https://moderncampground.com/murray-bridge-marina-camping-park-changes-hands-in-major-industry-sale/)**
  The freehold going concern of Murray Bridge Marina & Camping and Caravan Park, a 12-hectare property along the Murray River, has been sold. Located 75 kilometres southeast of Adelaide, the park features 156 accommodations, including 82 caravan sites, 11 cabins, 60 marina berths, and three houseboats. Acquired by the Orken family.

- **2026 — [Ray White in Strathalbyn and Murray Bridge join forces](https://www.raywhite.com/news-and-market-insights/news-media/ray-white-in-strathalbyn-and-murray-bridge-join-forces)**
  Donna and Richard Ytsma have handed over the reins of their Ray White Murray Bridge office to Mr Bagley, who has been operating the Ray White Strathalbyn business since 2022. Murray Bridge is described as still affordable, with an influx of younger buyers, investors, first home buyers and family buyers.
